findings.claim: The cumulative packet omitted unrelated new CLI, partition, and skill files.
findings.evidence: Packet assembly failed to resolve C-010 to its OpenSpec directory and therefore reviewed the full dirty tree.
findings.suggested_fix: Rebuild with the OpenSpec change name so files.txt scopes the packet.

findings.claim: Production stdio still advertised legacy MCP versions.
findings.evidence: CompassMcp::new used a profile whose supported versions were ProtocolVersion::KNOWN_VERSIONS.
findings.suggested_fix: Advertise only 2026-07-28 on stdio and reject the removed initialize lifecycle.

findings.claim: The cumulative packet included machine paths in unrelated local runtime state.
findings.evidence: The file is outside C-010's declared review surface and appeared only because packet scoping failed.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the declared C-010 files list when rebuilding the packet.
